title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Contingency Fee Clauses
content:
**1. Fee on money collected only.** Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, Ridgeline earns its contingency fee only on money actually collected; there is no fee on placements, letters, calls or accounts that pay nothing.

**2. Booking a collection.** Every consumer payment Ridgeline collects is booked to the agreement's trust balance with a contingency rate and a fee. The rate is the contingency rate of the agreement's tier for the account's stage on the collection date, or the legal forwarding programme's rate for an account in an open forwarded matter. The fee equals the amount collected multiplied by that rate, rounded to the cent.

**3. Stage and rate.** The stage of the account on the collection date selects the tier rate:

| Account stage on the collection date | Tier rate applied |
|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | the tier's Early-Out Placement contingency rate |
| Primary Placement | the tier's Primary Placement contingency rate |
| Secondary Placement | the tier's Secondary Placement contingency rate |
| Tertiary Placement | the tier's Tertiary Placement contingency rate |
| Warehouse Placement | the tier's Warehouse Placement contingency rate |
| Legal Review Placement | the tier's Legal Review Placement contingency rate |

**4. Agreement status.** Collections are booked only on agreements whose status is active, placement hold or runoff, as the agreement record shows.

**5. Settlements.** Settlement payments carry the same rate as any other collection; a settlement waiver carries no fee.

**6. Direct payments.** When the consumer pays the client directly, the client reports it within the tier's direct-pay reporting period, and a fee is booked equal to the payment multiplied by the stage rate and by the tier's direct-pay fee share percent, rounded to the cent — except that no fee is booked on a direct payment whose date is within the tier's direct-pay free window, in calendar days after the account's placement date. A direct payment the client reports late is still charged.

**7. Settlement authority.** The tier also sets the settlement authority reduction that applies to the client's accounts under the settlement charter.

## Points of judgement

| Item | Fee booked? |
|---|---|
| Consumer payment collected by Ridgeline on an active agreement | yes, amount multiplied by the stage rate |
| Settlement payment collected | yes, at the same rate as any other collection |
| Settlement waiver | no |
| Account placed but paying nothing | no |
| Direct payment dated outside the free window | yes, at the direct-pay share of the stage rate |
| Direct payment dated within the free window | no |
| Direct payment reported after the reporting period | yes, still charged |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A consumer pays 412.37 USD to Ridgeline on a Primary Placement account, under a tier whose Primary Placement rate is 25.0 percent. The fee is 412.37 USD multiplied by 25.0 percent, which is 103.0925 USD, rounded to the cent: 103.09 USD.

A consumer of a Secondary Placement account pays the client 200.00 USD directly, outside the free window, under a tier whose Secondary Placement rate is 30.0 percent and whose direct-pay fee share is 75.0 percent. The fee is 200.00 USD multiplied by 30.0 percent and by 75.0 percent: 45.00 USD.
